components.name: Structural obstruction clutter for future-safe carrier generation
components.project_addition: For a typed future-safe compiler with full generator set G and target Q*, define the monotone retained-set adequacy predicate Phi(S)=[Compile_S(P0)=Q*]. Inclusion-minimal deletion sets that falsify Phi form a generator cut clutter. Each minimal cut H has canonical forbidden-world witness Compile_(G\H)(P0) with exact full-language kill set H. Minimal Carrier Bases are precisely minimal transversals of this clutter, replacing the Bell-number forbidden-partition universe by a generator-side obstruction family.

components.name: Typed carrier plus semantic adequacy cut duality
components.project_addition: Separates carrier adequacy from quotient-level semantic reconstruction adequacy. Their deletion-failure families are upward closed, so the minimal joint cut clutter is the inclusion-minimal union of carrier cuts and semantic cuts. Minimal adequate primitive instruction sets are the minimal transversals of this joint clutter. Carrier cuts carry canonical forbidden-world partitions; semantic cuts carry explicit non-reconstructible descended-operation/relation witnesses.
